# qinyang/ui

> A shadcn registry of desktop-density components, agent interfaces and page templates.

Install any item with `npx shadcn@latest add https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/<name>.json`, or add `"@qinyang": "https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/{name}.json"` to `registries` in components.json and run `npx shadcn@latest add @qinyang/<name>`.

- [Registry index](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/registry.json)
- [Docs](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/)

## Foundations

- [Icon Chip](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/icon-chip/): Frames an icon so card and section headers match. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/icon-chip.json
- [Icons](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/icons.json): Rounded outline icon set used across the library. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/icons.json
- [Theme](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/theme.json): Design tokens, type scale and utilities every component in the library reads. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/theme.json
- [Typeset](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/typeset/): Styles long-form text in docs, articles and chat messages. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/typeset.json

## Forms

- [Accent Picker](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/accent-picker/): Lets people choose the theme's accent colour, remembered across visits. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/accent-picker.json
- [Button](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/button/): Triggers an action or submits a form. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/button.json
- [Button Group](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/button-group/): Joins related buttons into one control. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/button-group.json
- [Button Stateful](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/button-stateful/): A button that shows loading, success and error after a press. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/button-stateful.json
- [Calendar](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/calendar/): Month grid for picking a date or a range. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/calendar.json
- [Checkbox](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/checkbox/): Toggles a single option on or off. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/checkbox.json
- [Color Picker](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/color-picker/): Picks a colour by dragging, entering hex or choosing a preset. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/color-picker.json
- [Combobox](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/combobox/): Picks one option from a long list by typing to filter. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/combobox.json
- [Date Picker](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/date-picker/): Field that opens a calendar to pick one date. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/date-picker.json
- [Date Range Picker](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/date-range-picker/): Picks a start and end date from a calendar. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/date-range-picker.json
- [Expandable Control](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/expandable-control/): Button or chip that expands on click to reveal a label or action. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/expandable-control.json
- [Expanding Arrow Button](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/expanding-arrow-button/): Call-to-action button with an arrow sweep on hover. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/expanding-arrow-button.json
- [Field](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/field/): Ties a label, control, hint and error into one form field. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/field.json
- [Hold Action Button](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/hold-action-button/): Confirms a risky action by making the user press and hold. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/hold-action-button.json
- [Input](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/input/): Single-line text field. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/input.json
- [Input Group](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/input-group/): Input with icons, text or buttons inside the field. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/input-group.json
- [Input OTP](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/input-otp/): Enters a one-time code, one character per slot. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/input-otp.json
- [Label](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/label/): Names a form control. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/label.json
- [Multi Select](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/multi-select/): Searchable picker for choosing several options at once. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/multi-select.json
- [Native Select](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/native-select/): The browser's own select, styled as a field. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/native-select.json
- [Password Input](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/password-input/): Password field with a button to show or hide it. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/password-input.json
- [Radio](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/radio/): Picks exactly one option from a short list. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/radio.json
- [Range Slider Inline](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/range-slider-inline/): Slider that shows its label and value on the track. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/range-slider-inline.json
- [Segmented Control](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/segmented-control/): Switches a setting between a few options. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/segmented-control.json
- [Select](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/select/): Picks one option from a list. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/select.json
- [Select Morph](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/select-morph/): Select whose trigger unfolds into its option list. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/select-morph.json
- [Slide Action Button](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/slide-action-button/): Confirms an action when the user slides it to the end. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/slide-action-button.json
- [Slider](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/slider/): Picks a value or range by dragging. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/slider.json
- [Stepper](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/stepper/): Adjusts a number up or down in fixed steps. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/stepper.json
- [Swatch Picker](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/swatch-picker/): Picks one colour from a fixed palette. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/swatch-picker.json
- [Switch](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/switch/): Turns a single setting on or off. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/switch.json
- [Textarea](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/textarea/): Takes multi-line text input that grows with its content. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/textarea.json
- [Toggle Group](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/toggle-group/): Turns formatting or view options on and off. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/toggle-group.json
- [Wheel Picker](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/wheel-picker/): Picks a value by scrolling a wheel, as for times and dates. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/wheel-picker.json

## Overlays

- [Alert Dialog](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/alert-dialog/): Interrupts to confirm a destructive or important action. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/alert-dialog.json
- [Bottom Sheet](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/bottom-sheet/): A panel that slides up from the bottom and snaps to heights. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/bottom-sheet.json
- [Command](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/command/): Searchable list of actions, inline or in a dialog. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/command.json
- [Context Menu](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/context-menu/): Opens actions for an item on right-click or long-press. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/context-menu.json
- [Dialog](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/dialog/): Asks for a decision or input in a modal window. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/dialog.json
- [Drawer](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/drawer/): Side panel for navigation or secondary tasks over the page. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/drawer.json
- [Hover Card](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/hover-card/): Previews a linked item while it is hovered. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/hover-card.json
- [Menu](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/menu/): Dropdown of actions or options opened from a trigger. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/menu.json
- [Menu List](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/menu-list/): Keyboard-driven option list that leaves focus in the text field. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/menu-list.json
- [Morphing Modal](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/morphing-modal/): Dialog that moves between several views inside one panel. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/morphing-modal.json
- [Overflow Hint](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/overflow-hint/): Shows the full text of a truncated label on hover. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/overflow-hint.json
- [Popover](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/popover/): Floating panel for extra content or actions near a trigger. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/popover.json
- [Popover Morph](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/popover-morph/): Popover that grows out of its trigger and folds back. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/popover-morph.json
- [Toast](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/toast/): Shows brief notifications that dismiss themselves. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/toast.json
- [Tooltip](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/tooltip/): Labels a control with a short hint on hover or focus. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/tooltip.json

## Display

- [Accordion](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/accordion/): Stacks sections that expand one at a time or several together. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/accordion.json
- [Alert](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/alert/): Shows an inline message that can animate in and be dismissed. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/alert.json
- [Aspect Ratio](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/aspect-ratio/): Keeps content at a set ratio and animates ratio changes. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/aspect-ratio.json
- [Avatar](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/avatar/): Shows a person's photo or initials, alone or in a group. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/avatar.json
- [Avatar Generator](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/avatar-generator/): Draws a consistent illustrated avatar from a seed, with an editor. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/avatar-generator.json
- [Badge](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/badge/): Labels an item with a short status or category. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/badge.json
- [Card](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/card/): Groups related content and actions on one surface. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/card.json
- [Carousel](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/carousel/): Scrolls through slides one at a time. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/carousel.json
- [Collapsible](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/collapsible/): Shows and hides a section of content. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/collapsible.json
- [Empty State](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/empty-state/): Tells users a list or page is empty and what to do next. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/empty-state.json
- [Kbd](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/kbd/): Shows a keyboard key or shortcut. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/kbd.json
- [Loader](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/loader/): Shows that something is loading. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/loader.json
- [Page Header](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/page-header/): Title, context and actions at the top of an app page. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/page-header.json
- [Progress](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/progress/): Shows how far a task has come. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/progress.json
- [Resizable](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/resizable/): Split panes the user can resize or collapse. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/resizable.json
- [Scroll Area](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/scroll-area/): Scroll container with thin scrollbars that stay inside its frame. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/scroll-area.json
- [Separator](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/separator/): Divides groups of content with a hairline. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/separator.json
- [Settings Section](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/settings-section/): Layout for grouped settings pages. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/settings-section.json
- [Skeleton](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/skeleton/): Placeholder shape while content loads. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/skeleton.json
- [Stat Card](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/stat-card/): Card for a key metric and how it changed. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/stat-card.json
- [Theme Toggle](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/theme-toggle/): Switches the page between light and dark themes. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/theme-toggle.json
- [Usage Meter](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/usage-meter/): Shows how much of a quota has been used. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/usage-meter.json

## Navigation

- [Animated Sidebar](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/animated-sidebar/): App navigation sidebar that folds into an icon rail. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/animated-sidebar.json
- [App Shell](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/app-shell/): App frame with a header, rail sidebar and inset content panel. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/app-shell.json
- [Breadcrumb](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/breadcrumb/): Shows where the current page sits in the site hierarchy. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/breadcrumb.json
- [File Tree](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/file-tree/): Browses files and folders in a keyboard-navigable tree. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/file-tree.json
- [Icon Rail](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/icon-rail/): Narrow bar of icon buttons for switching between app sections. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/icon-rail.json
- [Menubar](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/menubar/): Row of menus for a desktop app window. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/menubar.json
- [Navigation Menu](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/navigation-menu/): Site navigation with panels of links. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/navigation-menu.json
- [Pagination](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/pagination/): Moves through pages of results in a list or table. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/pagination.json
- [Preview Rail](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/preview-rail/): Compact section navigation that previews each destination. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/preview-rail.json
- [Shared Layout Background](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/shared-layout-bg/): Hover highlight that follows the pointer across a group. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/shared-layout-bg.json
- [Tab Strip](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/tab-strip/): Switches between open documents or panels, with closing and reordering. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/tab-strip.json
- [Tabs](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/tabs/): Switches between related panels of content in one place. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/tabs.json
- [Toolbar](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/toolbar/): Groups related actions into one keyboard-navigable bar. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/toolbar.json
- [User Menu](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/user-menu/): Opens account actions for the signed-in user. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/user-menu.json
- [Workspace Switcher](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/workspace-switcher/): Switches between workspaces or teams from the sidebar header. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/workspace-switcher.json

## Text

- [Action Swap Blur](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/action-swap-blur/): A button that blurs its label and icon into the next state. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/action-swap-blur.json
- [Action Swap Roll](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/action-swap-roll/): A button that rolls its label and icon into the next state. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/action-swap-roll.json
- [Animated Number](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/animated-number/): Counts up to a number when it scrolls into view. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/animated-number.json
- [Digit Swap](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/digit-swap/): Animates a changing number by rolling only the characters that change. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/digit-swap.json
- [Marquee](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/marquee/): Scrolls content past in an endless loop. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/marquee.json
- [Number Ticker](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/number-ticker/): Number whose digits roll to each new value. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/number-ticker.json
- [Text Cascade](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/text-cascade/): Rolls text letter by letter whenever its value changes. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/text-cascade.json
- [Text Reveal](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/text-reveal/): Reveals a headline word by word on load or scroll. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/text-reveal.json
- [Text Scramble](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/text-scramble/): Scrambles text into its new value when it changes. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/text-scramble.json
- [Text Shimmer](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/text-shimmer/): Marks text as in progress with a moving highlight. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/text-shimmer.json

## Motion

- [Magnetic](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/magnetic/): Makes any element lean toward a nearby cursor. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/magnetic.json
- [Pull to Refresh](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/pull-to-refresh/): Refreshes a scrolling list when the user pulls it down. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/pull-to-refresh.json
- [Scroll Progress](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/scroll-progress/): Shows how far the reader has scrolled. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/scroll-progress.json
- [Scroll Reveal](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/scroll-reveal/): Brings content into view as it scrolls onscreen. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/scroll-reveal.json
- [Scroll To](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/scroll-to/): Button that scrolls to a section or position. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/scroll-to.json
- [Shader Background](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/shader-background/): Animated backdrop for hero sections and empty states. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/shader-background.json
- [Smooth Scroll](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/smooth-scroll/): Eases scrolling for a page or a scroll container. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/smooth-scroll.json
- [Sortable Stack](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/sortable-stack/): List the user can reorder by dragging or keyboard. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/sortable-stack.json

## Data

- [Data Table](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/data-table/): Browses, filters and acts on a set of rows. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/data-table.json
- [Table](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/table/): Shows large data sets that people sort, select and resize. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/table.json
- [Table Async](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/table-async/): Loads table rows page by page as the reader scrolls. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/table-async.json
- [Table Editable](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/table-editable/): Lets people edit cells and add or remove rows and columns. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/table-editable.json

## Agents

- [Agent Activity](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/agent-activity/): Shows what an agent did during a run as one activity stream. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/agent-activity.json
- [Agent Code Block](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/agent-code-block/): Displays code from an agent, including code still streaming in. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/agent-code-block.json
- [Agent Progress](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/agent-progress/): Shows that an agent is working, with a running timer. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/agent-progress.json
- [AI Sidebar](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/ai-sidebar/): Navigates folders, projects and files in an AI workspace. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/ai-sidebar.json
- [Chat App](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/chat-app.json): Agent workspace with a sidebar, conversation and prompt bar. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/chat-app.json
- [Citations](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/citations/): Links an answer's claims to the sources behind them. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/citations.json
- [Edited Files Card](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/edited-files-card/): Summarises the files an agent changed, with undo and review. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/edited-files-card.json
- [File Diff](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/file-diff/): Shows one file's changes as a diff, even while an agent streams them. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/file-diff.json
- [Image Generation](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/image-generation/): Shows a generated image from queued to finished, with its actions. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/image-generation.json
- [Message](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/message/): Lays out chat conversation rows by sender. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/message.json
- [Message Bubble](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/message-bubble/): Holds one chat message in a speech bubble. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/message-bubble.json
- [Message Scroller](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/message-scroller/): Keeps a chat view pinned to new messages until the reader scrolls up. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/message-scroller.json
- [Model Picker](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/model-picker/): Lets users choose an agent's model, effort or mode. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/model-picker.json
- [Reasoning Text](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/reasoning-text/): Status line that shows an agent is still working. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/reasoning-text.json
- [Streaming Response](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/streaming-response/): Shows an assistant reply as it streams, then offers copy and feedback. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/streaming-response.json
- [Terminal](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/terminal/): Runs a shell in the page or on your machine. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/terminal.json
- [Terminal View](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/terminal-view/): Shows command output and takes commands in a terminal panel. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/terminal-view.json
- [Thread List Item](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/thread-list-item/): Lists agent or chat threads in a sidebar. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/thread-list-item.json
- [Todo List](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/todo-list/): Shows an agent's step-by-step plan and its progress. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/todo-list.json
- [Tool Approval](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/tool-approval/): Asks the user to allow or deny an agent tool call. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/tool-approval.json
- [Tool Result](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/tool-result/): Shows what an agent tool call ran and what it returned. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/tool-result.json
- [Work Summary](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/work-summary/): Summarises the steps an agent took during one turn. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/work-summary.json

## Charts

- [Bar List](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/bar-list/): Ranks items by one measure with a bar behind each label. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/bar-list.json
- [Candlestick Chart](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/candlestick-chart/): Charts price movement over time with volume. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/candlestick-chart.json
- [Chart Utils](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/chart-utils/): Shared helpers for building and styling your own charts. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/chart-utils.json
- [Composition Chart](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/composition-chart/): Charts how each part's share of a whole changes over time. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/composition-chart.json
- [Donut Chart](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/donut-chart/): Shows how parts make up a whole as a ring. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/donut-chart.json
- [Funnel Chart](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/funnel-chart/): Shows how much drops off at each step of a process. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/funnel-chart.json
- [Heat Calendar](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/heat-calendar/): Shows daily activity over weeks or months as a calendar heat map. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/heat-calendar.json
- [Sparkline](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/sparkline/): Small inline chart that shows a trend. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/sparkline.json
- [Status Bar](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/status-bar/): Shows a service's status history and uptime. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/status-bar.json
- [Treemap](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/treemap/): Compares parts of a total as sized tiles. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/treemap.json
- [Trend Chart](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/trend-chart/): Plots how values change over time. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/trend-chart.json

- [Morphing Tabs](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/morphing-tabs/): Tabs the user can reorder, with content attached to the active tab. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/morphing-tabs.json

- [Agent Workspace](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/agent-workspace/): A full app for chatting with and supervising coding agents. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/agent-workspace.json
- [Personal Blog](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/blog/): Personal blog with a post list and an article page. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/blog.json
- [Docs Site](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/docs/): Documentation site layout with search, navigation and a page outline. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/docs.json
- [SaaS](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/saas/): Starter app with marketing pages, sign-in flows and a dashboard. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/saas.json
- [Code Editor](https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/docs/vscode/): Edit a project in the browser, with a shell on the same files. JSON: https://qinyangwang.github.io/ui/r/vscode.json
